method: Independent Haiku judges, one per query, shown only the current name+description listing for the cfgver-* family plus close neighbors (rocq-compile-oom). Scoped run: only the queries plausibly affected by cfgver-executor's new 'backward-branch loop exponential blowup' clause (added 2026-07-19, key_schedule_loop scaling-wall investigation), not a full 49+ sweep.
note: First pass (round 1) surfaced a real regression: Q66 (adversarial, tight-fuel bare-False residual) was won by cfgver-executor instead of cfgver-solve-vc -- the initial wording ('vm_compute/solve_vc takes way longer than expected', 'not a fuel/timeout problem to tune around') overlapped too much with the tight-fuel-False phrasing. Tightened the clause to require 'genuinely never terminates (no residual ever appears)' plus an explicit contrast sentence carving out the finishes-with-a-residual case for cfgver-solve-vc. Round 2 re-tested Q66 and the should-trigger Q65 and both passed; Q30/Q31/Q67 (regression checks from round 1) already passed round 1 and were not re-run.
